title: US Bond Crash Triggers MORTGAGE PANIC; Russia DECREE Blindsides Trump; AI Just Got Dangerous
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: US Treasuries are imploding; Treasury buybacks are too small and over-issuance is the cause, so yields keep driving borrowing costs higher.
7.58% mortgages and a 47% affordability gap put home prices under heavy downward pressure.
Confidence at a 12-year low and 6% inflation expectations threaten the consumer-driven economy.
A 40M-barrel SPR release covers only ~10 days of a ~4M bpd shortfall; Russia's data blackout adds supply-shock risk.
Russia hiding energy data conceals growing non-dollar energy trade with China and India.
US economy is betting on unsustainable debt-funded AI capex; revenue math 'is not mathing' and it may not end well.

calls.reason: Endless Treasury issuance into a saturated market; buybacks can't control yields; borrowing costs being driven relentlessly higher.
calls.quote: every critical borrowing cost in the United States is being driven relentlessly higher by all these yields

calls.reason: Same Treasury-breakdown thesis; 30-year near 5.6%, highest since 2001.

calls.quote: the planned release only covers approximately 10 days of that gap. Now, that is essentially meaningless
